changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE connection ADD COLUMN lifecycle_generation bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; CREATE TABLE provider_resource_repair ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY, identity_hash varchar(64) NOT NULL, kind varchar(48) NOT NULL, origin varchar(2048) NOT NULL, resource_type varchar(32) NOT NULL, parent_id varchar(256) NOT NULL, resource_id varchar(256) NOT NULL, ownership_hash varchar(96), state varchar(32) NOT NULL, created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, next_attempt_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, version bigint NOT NULL, attempt_epoch bigint NOT NULL, removal_attempts bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_provider_resource_repair_identity UNIQUE (identity_hash), CONSTRAINT ck_provider_resource_repair_state CHECK (state IN ('REGISTERING', 'PENDING', 'CHECKING', 'DISPATCHING', 'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION', 'NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION', 'CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED')) ); CREATE INDEX ix_provider_resource_repair_next_attempt ON provider_resource_repair(next_attempt_at, id); CREATE TABLE connection_provider_repair ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES workspace(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, connection_id bigint NOT NULL, repair_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES provider_resource_repair(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, credentials_generation bigint NOT NULL, lifecycle_generation bigint NOT NULL, connection_version bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_connection_provider_repair_owner FOREIGN KEY (connection_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES connection(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT uq_connection_provider_repair UNIQUE (workspace_id, connection_id, repair_id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_connection_provider_repair_resource ON connection_provider_repair(repair_id);
